استزيروا (form X)
# اُسْتُزِيرُوا (ustuzīrū) /us.tu.ziː.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَزَارَ (istazāra)
# اِسْتَزِيرُوا (istazīrū) /is.ta.ziː.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَزَارَ (istazāra)
